title: Integrate TDMA slot scheduling into Python node runtime
description:
Simulation proves LICHEN MAC design handles DEF CON scale (2000 radios): single channel 11% success, 64-channel hopping 94%, 2048-slot TDMA + 64 channels 100% success with 0 collisions.

TDMA primitives exist in timing/sfn.py (slot_for, TDMA_SLOT_MS, initial_startup_delay) but are not wired into node.py TX path.

Work:
1. Add TDMA scheduler to LinkLayer/Node - track SFN, compute slot via slot_for(), gate TX to slot window
2. Wire initial_startup_delay() into node startup - listen period, count nodes heard
3. Integrate with channel selection (slot=WHEN, channel=WHERE)
4. Add TDMA mode toggle (optional CSMA fallback for sparse networks)

Validation: extend lora-medium sim to use real node stack with TDMA, verify 0% collision at 2000-node scale
close_reason:
Integrated TDMA slot scheduling into Python node runtime:

1. LinkLayer: Added TDMA slot gating in drain_tx_queue()
   - tdma_enabled, tdma_num_slots, eui64 fields
   - _wait_for_tdma_slot() waits for assigned slot before TX
   - slot_for() from timing/sfn.py computes deterministic slot

2. Node: Added startup listen period
   - _startup_listen_period() counts neighbors during 30-60s listen
   - initial_startup_delay(nodes_heard) computes staggered start
   - Prevents synchronized TX storms after mass reboot

3. NodeConfig: Added tdma_enabled, tdma_num_slots, startup_listen_enabled, eui64

Validated: imports work, TDMA slot calculation correct, send() succeeds with TDMA enabled.
